title: Countdown Day 74
excerpt: Little by little, a new coherence began to emerge. That coherence was more a new way of believing, less a rebuilt system of beliefs. (8) From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
body:
Little by little, a new coherence began to emerge. That coherence was more a new way of believing, less a rebuilt system of beliefs. (8)

 From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
